headline: Down more than 6 Trillion Dollars
dek: The President says the stock market has lost more than 6 trillion dollars since the midterm elections, and blames the Democrats. Meanwhile, at a real American kitchen table…

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The Market is down more than 6 Trillion Dollars since the Democrats’ rather strange “win” on November 3rd. NASDAQ, by itself, is down 20%. This is 100% due to the fact that the Democrats are “BAD” due to their Anti Growth, and Retribution Only, Policies, and worse. If they don't change, FAST, it will only get worse. But fear not, our Country will soon be STRONG AGAIN — Lots of good things happening! President DONALD J. TRUMP
original.key: The Market is down more than 6 Trillion Dollars since the Democrats’ rather strange “win” on November 3rd.
original.context: Posted on 22 November 2026. The market figures, and the account of their cause, are the President’s. Steve is a fictional character.
